comment:
* An event that indicates that a dialog has encountered an error.
 *
 * @author jean deruelle
 * @since 2.0

variables.name: DIALOG_ACK_NOT_RECEIVED_TIMEOUT
variables.comment: * This event ID indicates that the transaction has timed out.

variables.name: DIALOG_ACK_NOT_SENT_TIMEOUT
variables.comment:
* This event ID indicates that there was an error sending a message using
     * the underlying transport.

variables.name: DIALOG_REINVITE_TIMEOUT
variables.comment: * This event ID indicates a timeout occured waiting to send re-INVITE ( for B2BUA)

methods.name: public int getErrorID()
methods.comment:
* Returns the ID of the error.
     *
     * @return Error ID.
